_comment: Template. Copy to pipeline.<env>.json in this folder (e.g. pipeline.dev.json; gitignored) and set "env" to the same name. Each file adds that env to the make consolidated-pipeline menu. Stages run in order (forex first: the rates tab must exist before accounts are imported); the run stops at the first failure, except stages with "run_after_failure": true (acknowledge, so a partly failed load still reports its outcomes to the Sheet). Modes: ledger-sheet-load sheet-sync|sheet-rebuild; ledger-sheet-extract extract|acknowledge; forex-database-load daily|historical|publish-sheet; ledger-database-load normal-sync|hard-sync. A sheet-rebuild stage also needs "confirm" set to the env name.
